data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 17c4f090da212e1ec206e1dc8cb77e30b4305ff7
* **skill:** /dso:sprint Phase 1 Preplanning Gate
* **epic_under_test:** 5d6e-86a9 (CI LLM-review parity)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

When /dso:sprint is invoked on an in_progress epic whose ticket has zero children (because all stories were previously created, executed, and closed in prior sessions), the Preplanning Gate should detect that all work is done and route directly to completion-verifier (Phase 6 Step 0.75) to determine whether the epic can be closed.

Per the auto-resume protocol (skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md section f):
  "Run .claude/scripts/dso ticket deps <primary_ticket_id> — if 100% complete, skip to Phase 6 (validation)"

And per the Preplanning Gate (skills/sprint/SKILL.md Step 1):
  zero children → Step 2b (Epic Complexity Evaluation) → which dispatches complexity-evaluator and then routes to preplanning/implementation-plan.

#### Actual Behavior

In the 2026-05-02 session, /dso:sprint was invoked on epic 5d6e-86a9 (CI LLM-review parity, status=in_progress). The epic had zero children returned by `ticket deps` because all 13 child stories had been closed in prior sessions. The sprint orchestrator reached the Preplanning Gate and was about to run the Clarity Gate Layer 2 (scope_certainty haiku dispatch) followed by Step 2b (Epic Complexity Evaluation), which would have dispatched /dso:implementation-plan or /dso:preplanning on an already-complete epic.

The user interrupted the session and asked to run the completion-verifier directly. The completion-verifier returned overall_verdict: FAIL (2 of 20 SCs failed — SC6 and SC10 require live in-session E2E execution with real CI).

### 3. Action History

1. User invoked /dso:sprint with no args; selected epic 5d6e-86a9 from the list.
2. ticket show 5d6e-86a9 returned status=in_progress.
3. auto-resume protocol ran: ticket deps returned zero children (all 13 stories previously closed).
4. auto-resume section (c) fired: "No children found — falling through to Preplanning Gate."
5. Drift detection: NO_DRIFT.
6. Clarity Gate Layer 1: ticket-clarity-check.sh → {"score": 7, "verdict": "pass"}.
7. Orchestrator was about to proceed to Layer 2 (haiku complexity eval) and then Step 2b.
8. User interrupted and requested completion-verifier instead.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* auto-resume.md section (c): triggers "fall through to Preplanning Gate" on zero children.
* auto-resume.md section (f): says "if 100% complete, skip to Phase 6" — but this check uses ticket deps, and deps returns zero children when all children are closed (closed tickets are excluded from deps output by default).
* The Preplanning Gate Step 1 counts children from ticket deps. Zero children → Step 2b (complexity eval + preplanning). The gate has no branch for "zero children AND all children are closed (epic is done)".

### Root Cause Hypothesis (observed, not inferred)

ticket deps excludes closed tickets from its output. When all children are closed, zero children is returned — identical to the output for an epic with no children at all. The auto-resume and Preplanning Gate cannot distinguish "no children yet" from "all children closed" using ticket deps alone.

A fix could use: ticket list --parent=<epic-id> --include-archived (or equivalent) to check whether closed children exist, and if closed children exist + zero open children, route to Phase 6 instead of preplanning.
data.title: [sprint/Phase1]: Epic with all children closed triggers Preplanning Gate instead of completion-verifier -> sprint would have run /dso:preplanning on a complete epic
